title: Data management extract to the Server folder
author: Unknown
content: How do I specify in a data management task to extract the data to the cube/scenario/workflow step folder and not the user's folder under file share?
solution_text: Create a Data Mgmt Export Sequence under Application > Data Sources. Assign your Export Data DM step to this DM Export Sequence data source. Then assign this Export Sequence to your Import workflow step.
